strategy.thesis: Singapore's state investment company; 'Life Sciences & Agri-Food' is one of Temasek's stated key focus investment areas (alongside Consumer/Media/Technology and Non-Bank Financial Services), through which it takes large direct stakes in healthcare providers and biotech — e.g. a controlling 59% stake in India's largest private hospital chain.

summary.en: Singapore's sovereign investment company; Life Sciences & Agri-Food is one of its named strategic sector focus areas, with direct large-stake healthcare investments such as a controlling stake in India's Manipal Health Enterprises hospital chain.

sources.title: Temasek Holdings
sources.supports: Life Sciences & Agri-Food as a named strategic sector; Manipal Health Enterprises 59% stake (April 2023); InnovaFeed investment (Nov 2020)
sources.quote: Its key focus investment areas include Consumer, Media & Technology, Life Sciences & Agri-Food, and Non-Bank Financial Services... Temasek announced that it would acquire an additional 41 percent stake in Bengaluru-based Manipal Health Enterprises (MHE), resulting in a total stake of 59 per cent.

verification_notes: Direct temasek.com.sg fetches were blocked (403) this session; sourced via Wikipedia only, a single (reputable, tertiary) source. Distinct from 'Temasek Life Sciences Accelerator' (sea-temasek-life-sciences-accelerator), already in the roster as a separate seed-stage accelerator program — this entity is the parent sovereign fund itself, which also makes large direct majority-stake healthcare investments well outside the accelerator's scope. Worklist contained both 'Temasek' and 'Temasek Holdings' as separate mention rows referring to the same organization; merged into one entity. AUM/fund-size figures not sourced this session (Temasek's portfolio-wide NAV is publicly reported but was not independently re-verified via a fetched source this round) — left out rather than guessed.
